_comment: User config written by install.sh to ~/.config/firetv-receiver/config.json. Leave name/bind null to use the OS hostname and auto-detected LAN address. pin_display: auto, qt, none. inject: ydotool (live) or log (dry run). keymap/voice_config/cert_dir are optional absolute paths. The official app hardcodes HTTPS 8080 and WSS 9090, and DIAL requires port 8009 or 8019; change the other ports only for testing.
